T_original.description: The original number of 12-hour time periods (includes 0h).

start_year.description: Earliest year of data to include.

CRS.description: Coordinate reference system used for GeoDataFrames.

H.description: Forecast horizon in hours (must be multiple of 12).

demand_lead_time.description: Lead-time to observe the first demand (evacuation window).

segments.description: Number of subdivisions inside each 12-hour period.

n_states_at_terminal.description: Target maximum number of discretized states at terminal period.

num_scen.description: The number of AR(1) scenarios to simulate.

ar_1_sample.description: If 1, use AR(1) model of forecast error; else use true samples to train the MC model.

X_rotate.description: Rotation coefficient for projecting cross-track error onto longitude axis

Y_rotate.description: Rotation coefficient for projecting cross-track error onto latitude axis

study_region_dist.description: Maximum lateral distance from study region that can generate demand (miles)

demand_frac_by_cat.description: Normalized evacuation demand fraction as a function of hurricane category (0–5)
